summary: Comprehensive testing done for PagneMarket MVP. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests PASS covering auth (login/register/me), catalog (categories/products/trending/creators/models with filters), cart (add/get/update/remove/clear), favorites toggle, orders (create clears cart + list) and messaging (send/conversations/messages). Frontend: full E2E flow via Playwright on mobile viewport (390x844) — login with demo credentials → Home (hero + cta-shop + cta-models, categories, trending, creators, models grids all render with correct testIDs) → Shop (search-input, chips, shop-product-{id}, cart-btn) → Product Detail (back-btn, fav-btn, add-to-cart, buy-now) → Cart (cart-item, inc/dec, checkout-btn) → Checkout (address/city/phone, pay-card, place-order) → Done screen (done-back). Models tab (model-chip-{cat}, want-model-{id}) and Creator Profile (tab-models/tab-bio, chat-input + send-msg with 'Message envoyé' confirmation) work correctly. Design/content issue: several Unsplash image URLs in seed data don't correspond to African fashion — the model 'Robe Enfant Fleurie' and 'Robe de mariage Aïcha' render as sneakers/shoes (photo-1600185365483-26d7a4cc7519 is a Nike sneaker). Payment is MOCKED as expected (order is created with paymentStatus='paid' without any real processor).

issues: Some Unsplash image IDs in backend seed do not depict African fashion. Confirmed: photo-1600185365483-26d7a4cc7519 resolves to a Nike Air Max sneaker and is used for models 'Robe de mariage Aïcha' and 'Robe Enfant Fleurie'. Replace with curated African fashion / wax pagne / boubou images to keep brand promise. Files: /app/backend/server.py lines ~569-576 (model_images) and ~500-511 (fabric_images) — audit each URL.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:18 — move pointerEvents="none" into the style object.

action_items: Replace non-fashion Unsplash image URLs in seed_database() (fabric_images and model_images) with curated African fashion photos. At minimum, remove or swap photo-1600185365483-26d7a4cc7519 (sneaker). Consider re-seeding after audit.
Fix deprecated pointerEvents prop in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx (PrewarmIcons) — pass pointerEvents via the style prop instead of the top-level prop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has both /api/models and /api/models/{mid} plus catalog routes correctly ordered — no route-shadowing risk with /api/products/trending vs /api/products/{pid} (trending defined before {pid} — good).
Cart/favorites/orders all consistently filter out MongoDB _id via projection {'_id': 0} and pop('_id') on inserted docs — good.
JWT_SECRET has a hardcoded fallback ('pagnemarket-secret-key-change-me-2026') — acceptable for MVP but must be set via env in production.
Payment is MOCKED — order status is auto set to 'paid' with no verification (explicitly acknowledged in problem statement).
Backend startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event which is fine for FastAPI current versions but consider migrating to lifespan handlers eventually.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; used already-seeded demo user (demo@pagnemarket.com / Demo1234!) and auto-seeded catalog. Test users created via register endpoint are prefixed 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL taken from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All 24 pytest cases pass sequentially in ~5s. When running with pytest-xdist (default addopts in /app/backend/pytest.ini uses -n auto --dist loadscope), Cart and Orders tests may show race conditions because both use the same demo user cart concurrently — use -o addopts='' to run sequentially, or split fixtures per-class using unique test users. Frontend fully wired to backend; all testIDs match the review request's kebab-case scheme.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional bugs blocking MVP. Sole content issue is image curation (see design_issues).
